roadmap.title: Nephilim story run
roadmap.description: Finish Dante’s campaign on Nephilim, buy early upgrades, attempt the Mission 1 carousel challenge, and let the common combat, orb, and style totals accumulate.

roadmap.title: Son of Sparda and collectible cleanup
roadmap.description: Use the complete ability set while clearing Son of Sparda to collect every Key and Lost Soul, open every Secret Door, finish all Secret Missions, maximize mission completion, and handle the remaining mission challenges.

roadmap.title: Nephilim SSS ranks
roadmap.description: With every mission at 100% completion, replay all 20 missions on Nephilim for SSS results while avoiding deaths and preserving the score multipliers.

roadmap.title: Base-game difficulty and grind cleanup
roadmap.description: Clear Heaven or Hell, Dante Must Die, and Hell and Hell, purchase the remaining upgrades, then farm only the cumulative totals still unfinished.

roadmap.title: Vergil’s Downfall first run and completion
roadmap.description: Finish the six-mission DLC, defeat its new enemies, collect every upgrade item, and bring all six mission completion records to 100%.

roadmap.title: Vergil’s Downfall ranks and difficulties
roadmap.description: Earn SSS on all six Nephilim missions, then clear Son of Sparda, Heaven or Hell, Vergil Must Die, and Hell and Hell.

achievements.displayName: Time to go to work guys!
achievements.description: Purchase your first upgrade
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Buy Dante’s first combat upgrade from the @mechanic{Upgrade} menu.

guide.context: Upgrade points come from combat performance, and the first purchase can be made during the opening mission.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{Upgrade} menu at a @loc{Divinity Statue} or between missions, select any affordable Dante ability, and confirm the purchase.

achievements.description: Defeat your pursuer
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Defeat the pursuing demon at the end of @loc{Mission 1: Found}.

guide.context: This boss is mandatory campaign progress, so the achievement cannot be locked out on a completed save.

steps.text: Follow the objectives through @loc{Mission 1: Found}, defeat the pursuing demon in the final arena, and let the post-fight sequence finish.

achievements.displayName: It's got to stay in the family
achievements.description: Acquire Arbiter
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Obtain the @item{Arbiter} demon weapon during @loc{Mission 2: Home Truths}.

guide.context: Arbiter also breaks red crystal barriers that block collectibles in earlier missions.

steps.text: Complete the mandatory Arbiter training sequence in @loc{Mission 2: Home Truths} and finish its prompts until the weapon remains in Dante’s loadout.

achievements.description: Acquire Osiris
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Obtain the @item{Osiris} angel weapon during @loc{Mission 2: Home Truths}.

guide.context: Osiris cuts blue vines, opening several collectible paths on later mission replays.

steps.text: Continue the required flashback sections in @loc{Mission 2: Home Truths}, complete the Osiris tutorial, and retain the weapon after the sequence.

achievements.displayName: Only kind of gift worth giving
achievements.description: Acquire the Angel Boost ability
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Acquire @mechanic{Angel Boost} in @loc{Mission 3: Bloodline}.

guide.context: Angel Boost is required for long gaps and several collectibles, including routes in missions already completed.

steps.text: Reach the blue rose during @loc{Mission 3: Bloodline}, finish the movement tutorial, and perform the prompted Angel Boost.

achievements.description: Survive the encounter with the Tyrant
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Survive the @enemy{Tyrant} encounter in @loc{Mission 4: Under Watch}.

guide.context: The encounter is part of the critical path and can be retried from a nearby checkpoint after defeat.

steps.text: Advance through @loc{Mission 4: Under Watch}, complete the mandatory Tyrant battle, and continue until the result registers.

achievements.displayName: This baby sure can pack a punch
achievements.description: Acquire Eryx
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Acquire the @item{Eryx} demon weapon in @loc{Mission 6: Secret Ingredient}.

guide.context: Eryx smashes red floor crystals and opens pickups that cannot be reached on the first trip through early missions.

steps.text: Finish the boss sequence in @loc{Mission 6: Secret Ingredient}, then complete the Eryx tutorial so the gauntlets are added permanently.

achievements.description: Help Phineas retrieve his eye
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Recover @npc{Phineas}’s eye during @loc{Mission 8: Eyeless}.

guide.context: The eye recovery is a mandatory objective within the main campaign.

steps.text: Follow the objective markers in @loc{Mission 8: Eyeless}, retrieve Phineas’s missing eye, and return it as directed.

achievements.displayName: You are not a Human, are you?
achievements.description: Acquire the Devil Trigger ability
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Unlock @mechanic{Devil Trigger} during @loc{Mission 9: Devil Inside}.

guide.context: Devil Trigger launches nearby enemies and later becomes a useful safety tool for style and challenge cleanup.

steps.text: Complete the compulsory combat sequence in @loc{Mission 9: Devil Inside} and activate Devil Trigger when the tutorial requests it.

achievements.description: Acquire Aquila
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Acquire the @item{Aquila} angel weapon after @loc{Mission 10: Bad News}.

guide.context: Aquila’s Round Trip removes blue vines and enables the remaining blocked collectible routes.

steps.text: Defeat the mission boss in @loc{Mission 10: Bad News} and finish the following sequence that adds Aquila to Dante’s arsenal.

achievements.displayName: More than just a few sparks
achievements.description: Acquire Revenant
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Acquire the @item{Revenant} shotgun during @loc{Mission 12: Under Siege}.

guide.context: Revenant is awarded by mandatory story progress and does not require a hidden pickup.

steps.text: Continue through @loc{Mission 12: Under Siege} until Dante receives Revenant, then finish the weapon introduction.

achievements.description: Defeat Mundus' spawn
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Mundus’ Spawn} at the end of @loc{Mission 14: Last Dance}.

guide.context: Mission Select keeps the boss available for replay after the first clear.

steps.text: Complete both phases of the mandatory boss fight in @loc{Mission 14: Last Dance} and remain through the closing scene.

achievements.displayName: You're not going to shoot me
achievements.description: Acquire Kablooey
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Acquire the @item{Kablooey} firearm during @loc{Mission 16: The Plan}.

guide.context: Kablooey darts can be planted on separate enemies and detonated together to raise combat style quickly.

steps.text: Reach the scripted weapon handoff in @loc{Mission 16: The Plan} and complete the Kablooey tutorial encounter.

achievements.description: Help Vergil open the Vault
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Help @npc{Vergil} activate the Vault in @loc{Mission 18: Demon’s Den}.

guide.context: The four-generator objective is compulsory and can be completed in any order.

steps.text: Activate all four generators in @loc{Mission 18: Demon’s Den}, return to the central chamber, and finish the Vault-opening sequence with Vergil.

achievements.description: Defeat Mundus
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Mundus} in @loc{Mission 19: Face of the Demon}.

guide.context: This fight ends the Mundus story arc but is followed by one final campaign mission.

steps.text: Complete every phase of the Mundus boss battle in @loc{Mission 19: Face of the Demon} and allow the ending transition to play.

achievements.displayName: The end? Don't bet on it
achievements.description: Complete the final mission on Human, Devil Hunter or Nephilim difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Mission 20: The End} while playing on any initial setting: Human, Devil Hunter, or Nephilim.

guide.context: Progress is shared among the three initial difficulties, and clearing any one of them unlocks Son of Sparda.

steps.text: Select Human, Devil Hunter, or Nephilim for @loc{Mission 20: The End}, defeat the final opponent, and complete the mission results screen.

achievements.displayName: Looks like it's your lucky day
achievements.description: Complete a level without taking any damage
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Clear any mission without Dante taking damage; @loc{Mission 15: The Trade} is the shortest low-risk choice.

guide.context: Mission 15 permits its combat encounters to be bypassed, and checkpoint restart is available if Dante is hit.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Mission 15: The Trade} on Human after learning @mechanic{Angel Boost}, skip the optional fights, and restart the checkpoint immediately if Dante loses health.
Reach the mission results screen with no damage recorded during the successful run.

achievements.description: Complete Furnace of Souls without taking damage from the furnace
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Mission 17: Furnace of Souls} while avoiding every furnace flame.

guide.context: Enemy damage does not invalidate this specific condition; only contact with the furnace hazard matters.

steps.text: Move through each furnace cycle only after the flame wave passes, and reload the previous checkpoint whenever the furnace damages Dante.
Complete the rest of @loc{Mission 17: Furnace of Souls} after a run in which no furnace strike connected.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies by pushing them into the Hurricane ride on Mission 1
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies by launching them into the moving Hurricane carousel during @loc{Mission 1: Found}.

guide.context: The carousel-kill total persists between mission replays, so all 10 kills do not need to occur in one run.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Mission 1: Found} until combat begins beside the Hurricane ride.
Use @mechanic{Hightime} or Devil Trigger to lift enemies into the moving carousel structure, and repeat until 10 enemies die from the ride.

achievements.displayName: A man with guts and honor
achievements.description: Reach the end of the descent on Mission 6 having killed all of the enemies
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Kill every enemy during the timed descent at the start of @loc{Mission 6: Secret Ingredient}.

guide.context: The timer is the only pressure point; Heaven or Hell makes the cleanup easier because ordinary targets die in one hit.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Mission 6: Secret Ingredient} and begin the opening timed platform descent.
Stop at every enemy spawn, kill the entire group, and reach the bottom before the timer expires without leaving a target alive.

achievements.description: Navigate the Sky Bridge on Mission 16 without hitting the lasers
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Cross the red-laser skybridge in @loc{Mission 16: The Plan} without touching a laser.

guide.context: A laser hit can be erased by restarting the current checkpoint, although the restart counts as a death for mission scoring.

steps.text: Wait in front of each laser pattern, jump only when a gap opens, add @mechanic{Angel Boost} to clear the beam, and cross the full first laser skybridge untouched.

achievements.description: Complete a level with 2 minutes or less on the clock
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Finish any mission with no more than two minutes on the mission clock; use @loc{Mission 15: The Trade}.

guide.context: Mission 15 is short and allows its combat sections to be skipped; Mission 3 is another option after Angel Boost is unlocked.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Mission 15: The Trade} on Human, move directly between objectives, bypass the combat encounters, and finish before the timer exceeds 2:00.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies using nothing but firearms
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Earn 50 cumulative enemy kills using only Dante’s firearms for each credited kill.

guide.context: The cumulative value is visible under @mechanic{Extras → Achievements} or @mechanic{Extras → Stats}.

steps.text: On Human or Heaven or Hell, damage and finish enemies only with Ebony & Ivory, Revenant, or Kablooey until the firearm counter reaches 50.

achievements.displayName: In the name of my father
achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies using nothing but Demon weapons
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Earn 100 cumulative enemy kills using only @mechanic{Demon weapons} for each credited kill.

guide.context: Arbiter and Eryx are Dante’s Demon weapons, and the running total can be checked from the Extras menu.

steps.text: Replay enemy-heavy missions and use only @item{Arbiter} or @item{Eryx} from first hit through killing blow until 100 kills register.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies using nothing but Angel weapons
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Earn 100 cumulative enemy kills using only @mechanic{Angel weapons} for each credited kill.

guide.context: Osiris and Aquila are Dante’s Angel weapons, and the counter accumulates across mission replays.

steps.text: Replay enemy-heavy missions and use only @item{Osiris} or @item{Aquila} from first hit through killing blow until 100 kills register.

achievements.description: Slay 100 Demons
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Kill 100 demons across Dante’s main campaign and mission replays.

guide.context: Normal progression supplies far more than 100 targets, so dedicated farming is unnecessary.

steps.text: Continue the main campaign and defeat enemies normally until the cumulative demon total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Slay 1,000 Demons
achievements.sortReason: Finish during later difficulty runs or final farming.
achievements.summary: Kill 1,000 demons across Dante’s main campaign and mission replays.

guide.context: The total grows during every required difficulty run and can be monitored under Extras.

steps.text: Complete the required base-game difficulty playthroughs before farming; their kills all contribute toward 1,000.

achievements.displayName: Looks like we have a winner
achievements.description: Slay 5,000 Demons
achievements.sortReason: Finish during later difficulty runs or final farming.
achievements.summary: Kill 5,000 demons in Dante’s main game; Vergil’s Downfall kills do not count.

guide.context: The required base-game playthroughs and Nephilim SSS runs may leave the counter near 4,200, making this a late cleanup task.

steps.text: Complete every base-game difficulty and Nephilim SSS objective before checking the demon total under @mechanic{Extras → Stats}.
Replay @loc{Mission 10: Bad News} on Heaven or Hell and clear its enemy waves repeatedly until the base-game counter reaches 5,000.

achievements.description: Gain a SSS Style Rank during combat
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Raise the live combat style meter to @mechanic{SSS} during any battle.

guide.context: Repeated attacks lose style value; variety, Demon Evade, and simultaneous Kablooey detonations raise the meter efficiently.

steps.text: Fight a durable group, alternate weapons and moves without taking a hit, use a successful @mechanic{Demon Evade} for its boost, and continue until the combat rank reaches SSS.

achievements.description: Earn 1,500 Style Bonuses
achievements.sortReason: Finish during later difficulty runs or final farming.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 1,500 named @mechanic{Style Bonuses} across Dante’s battles.

guide.context: This is a persistent statistic rather than a single-combat target, and progress is listed in Extras.

steps.text: Vary attacks, launch and juggle enemies, evade cleanly, and finish fights during the required playthroughs until @mechanic{Extras → Stats} shows 1,500 Style Bonuses.

achievements.displayName: This is my kind of rain
achievements.description: Spend 10,000 Red Orbs
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first campaign run.
achievements.summary: Spend a cumulative 10,000 @item{Red Orbs} at shops or Divinity Statues.

guide.context: Purchases across the save contribute, including items bought while preparing for harder difficulties.

steps.text: Use Divinity Statues or the between-mission shop to buy upgrades and consumables until total Red Orb spending reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Spend 50,000 Red Orbs
achievements.sortReason: Finish during later difficulty runs or final farming.
achievements.summary: Spend a cumulative 50,000 @item{Red Orbs} at shops or Divinity Statues.

guide.context: If normal progression leaves a shortfall, Heaven or Hell runs of Mission 20 provide a quick repeatable source of Red Orbs.

steps.text: Complete the required difficulty runs and spend earned Red Orbs on upgrades or consumables.
If needed, replay @loc{Mission 20: The End} on Heaven or Hell, then spend the remaining Red Orbs until the lifetime total reaches 50,000.

achievements.description: Upgrade Dante's health to maximum
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Fill every segment of Dante’s health bar by obtaining all available @item{Health Cross} upgrades.

guide.context: Permanent health growth is connected to Secret Mission rewards and the Divinity Statue inventory, making full collectible cleanup the efficient first step.

steps.text: Collect all 21 Keys, open all 21 Secret Doors, free all 80 Lost Souls, and complete all 21 Secret Missions so every health-related reward is available.
At each Divinity Statue, purchase every Health Cross upgrade still offered and verify that Dante’s health bar has reached its maximum length.

achievements.description: Upgrade Dante's Devil Trigger to maximum
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Fill Dante’s entire Devil Trigger gauge by obtaining every @item{Devil Trigger Cross} upgrade.

guide.context: Devil Trigger capacity is permanent across mission replays, so Secret Mission cleanup and Divinity Statue purchases can be completed on different difficulties.

steps.text: Collect all 21 Keys, open all 21 Secret Doors, free all 80 Lost Souls, and complete all 21 Secret Missions to secure every collectible-linked Devil Trigger reward.
Visit a Divinity Statue after the full cleanup, purchase every Devil Trigger Cross upgrade still offered, and confirm that Dante’s gauge has reached maximum capacity.

achievements.description: Purchase all of Dante's combat upgrades
achievements.sortReason: Finish during later difficulty runs or final farming.
achievements.summary: Purchase every ability listed in Dante’s @mechanic{combat Upgrade} menu.

guide.context: Upgrade points accumulate over repeated missions, and the five required difficulty runs provide ample combat opportunities.

steps.text: Finish the campaign and difficulty runs while earning high combat ranks to collect upgrade points.
Open the Upgrade menu and purchase every remaining move for Rebellion, Arbiter, Osiris, Eryx, Aquila, Ebony & Ivory, Revenant, and Kablooey.

achievements.description: Find all of the Keys
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Collect all 21 Copper, Argent, Gold, and Ivory Keys across Dante’s 20 missions.

guide.context: Keys remain collected across every difficulty and are used to unlock Secret Doors of the matching color.

collectibles.name: Mission 1 Copper Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 1: Found}, after the first Lost Soul visible on the route
collectibles.method: Follow the wooden platforms branching left to the Copper Key.

collectibles.name: Mission 2 Copper Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 2: Home Truths}, Main Hall upper floor
collectibles.method: Take the right staircase and enter the upstairs room holding the Copper Key.

collectibles.name: Mission 2 Argent Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 2: Home Truths}, after Lost Souls 3 and 4
collectibles.method: Use @item{Eryx} to break the red crystal embedded in the floor.

collectibles.name: Mission 3 Copper Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 3: Bloodline}, near the first Divinity Statue
collectibles.method: Before leaving the opening area, enter the left passage and break the red barrier.

collectibles.name: Mission 4 Argent Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 4: Under Watch}, lower side of the first split staircase
collectibles.method: After descending the right staircase, turn into the nearby dead end and smash the floor crystal with @item{Eryx}.

collectibles.name: Mission 4 Gold Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 4: Under Watch}, fountain-square terrace
collectibles.method: Use the blue grip to reach the terrace, then enter the building accessible from that level.

collectibles.name: Mission 5 Copper Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 5: Virility}, first large warehouse combat platform
collectibles.method: After combat, climb the boxes beside the right-hand fence and drop behind the fence.

collectibles.name: Mission 5 Argent Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 5: Virility}, upper level near Lost Soul 5
collectibles.method: From the upper level, follow the alternating blue and red grips, pass the Eryx-crystal platform, and continue by blue grips.

collectibles.name: Mission 6 Copper Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 6: Secret Ingredient}, mission start
collectibles.method: Turn Dante around immediately after the mission loads and collect the key behind the starting position.

collectibles.name: Mission 7 Copper Key A
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 7: Overturn}, after the first two boosted blue grips
collectibles.method: Look high to the right, cut the blue vines with @item{Aquila}, and follow the revealed grips.

collectibles.name: Mission 7 Argent Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 7: Overturn}, Divinity Statue area
collectibles.method: Face away from the Divinity Statue and take the side platform reached by a blue grip.

collectibles.name: Mission 7 Copper Key B
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 7: Overturn}, late crystal-floor arena
collectibles.method: Break the red floor crystal, win the fight, ride the blue grip upward, then turn around to spot the key.

collectibles.name: Mission 8 Argent Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 8: Eyeless}, railway tunnel after the first battle
collectibles.method: Ignore the first opening on the left, continue through the tunnel, turn right, and clear the blue vines.

collectibles.name: Mission 9 Gold Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 9: Devil Inside}, large square combat chamber
collectibles.method: Use a live enemy as a platform by chaining Demon Pull with Enemy Step, or Angel Lift with Payoff, until Dante reaches the high balcony.

collectibles.name: Mission 11 Copper Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 11: The Order}, sealed base corridor
collectibles.method: Pass the closing door first, backtrack to the entrance end, and enter through the broken black wall beyond the corridor.

collectibles.name: Mission 13 Gold Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 13: Devil’s Dalliance}, first opened arena
collectibles.method: Turn back toward the entrance, climb to Lost Soul 1, then take the blue-grip route to the platform on the right.

collectibles.name: Mission 15 Copper Key A
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 15: The Trade}, after stomping the container stack three times
collectibles.method: Before taking the next blue grips, vault over the containers on the left.

collectibles.name: Mission 15 Copper Key B
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 15: The Trade}, bus platform
collectibles.method: Pull the bus, then turn left and climb to the raised platform.

collectibles.name: Mission 16 Gold Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16: The Plan}, floor 105
collectibles.method: After the second elevator ride, turn right and walk behind the elevator car.

collectibles.name: Mission 17 Ivory Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 17: Furnace of Souls}, arch after the grip-platform sequence
collectibles.method: From beneath the arch, take the extra blue grips on the right, cut through the blue vines, and collect the key.

collectibles.name: Mission 18 Argent Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 18: Demon’s Den}, second tunnel on the right
collectibles.method: At the large floor gap, look below, drop into the lower passage, and follow its left branch.

achievements.description: Open all of the Secret Doors
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Open all 21 Secret Doors across Dante’s main campaign.

guide.context: A Secret Door opens only after its matching Copper, Argent, Gold, or Ivory Key has been collected; an opened door stays open on every difficulty.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 1 — Air Brawl
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 1: Found}, corridor inside the building
collectibles.method: After escaping the giant hand, enter the right-hand corridor and open the Copper Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 3 — Simple Eradication
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 2: Home Truths}, first mansion room after returning
collectibles.method: Drop to the lower floor and open the visible Copper Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 8 — Stylish Victory
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 2: Home Truths}, outdoor traversal after Eva’s portrait
collectibles.method: Cross the red scratches and blue vines, then Angel Boost over the broken floor on the right to the small room and its Copper Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 11 — What Goes Around
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 3: Bloodline}, ascent toward the blue rose
collectibles.method: After learning @mechanic{Angel Boost}, cross to the isolated platform with the Argent Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 2 — Simple Traversal
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 4: Under Watch}, second Y-shaped intersection
collectibles.method: Clear the enemies, take the right branch, use the blue grip, and follow the balcony to the Copper Door behind blue vines.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 13 — Flawless Conquest
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 4: Under Watch}, balconies near the second camera eye
collectibles.method: Backtrack across the balconies and combine Angel Boost with the blue grip to reach the Argent Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 4 — Demonic Conflict
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 5: Virility}, boxes beyond the Divinity Statue
collectibles.method: Climb the box pile on the right and cross to the left-side platform with the Copper Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 16 — Displaced Skirmish
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 5: Virility}, four-way corridor junction
collectibles.method: From the nearby Vital Star, return to the junction, turn left past two green pools, and break through the red scratches to the Argent Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 6 — Rapid Descent
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 6: Secret Ingredient}, tunnel after the timed descent
collectibles.method: Pass the Divinity Statue and jump to the left-side platform containing the Copper Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 17 — Divergent Slaughter
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 7: Overturn}, container platform
collectibles.method: Demon Pull the container, climb onto it, turn back, and enter the fenced area with the Gold Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 5 — Angelic Warfare
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 7: Overturn}, arena after the second Copper Key
collectibles.method: Smash the floor crystal, complete the spawned fight, and open the Copper Door on that combat platform.

collectibles.name: Door 7 (A Taste of Heaven)
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 8: Eyeless}, beyond the first red crystal wall
collectibles.method: Turn right immediately, remove the blue vines with @item{Aquila}, and open the Copper Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 12 — Moderate Traversal
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 8: Eyeless}, first area after the Divinity Statue
collectibles.method: Enter the left alcove, break the red scratches, and open the Argent Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 20 — Subsistence
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 9: Devil Inside}, building after the Divinity Statue route
collectibles.method: Enter the building reached after the blue-grip traversal and open the clearly visible Gold Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 10 — The Power Within
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 11: The Order}, base corridor after blue vines
collectibles.method: Sprint left through the corridor, turn right at its end, ignore the red scratches, break the Eryx crystals, turn left, and cross the closing doorway before it seals.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 21 — Shenanigans
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 13: Devil’s Dalliance}, first opened arena
collectibles.method: Climb above the entrance to Lost Soul 1, then use the blue-grip route leading to the left-side platform and its Ivory Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 15 — Hasty Acquisition
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 13: Devil’s Dalliance}, Divinity Statue after Round 5
collectibles.method: Descend from the left side of the statue platform to reach the Argent Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 18 — Extreme Traversal
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16: The Plan}, elevators on floor 106
collectibles.method: After the elevator-front battle, go behind the elevator, enter the stairwell, and descend to the Gold Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 9 — Bait and Switch
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16: The Plan}, end of the collapsing skybridge
collectibles.method: Circle around the elevators after escaping the collapsing bridge and open the Copper Door.

collectibles.name: Door 19 (A Day in Hell)
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 17: Furnace of Souls}, platform beyond the Divinity Statue
collectibles.method: After the next fight, find the red grip near the Lost Soul wall and pull it to reveal the route to the distant Gold Door.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 14 — Colossal Triumph
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 18: Demon’s Den}, second tunnel on the left
collectibles.method: When the tunnel opens into a wider space, cross to the Argent Door on the left.

achievements.description: Free half of the Lost Souls
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Free 40 of the 80 @npc{Lost Souls} in Dante’s main campaign.

guide.context: Lost Souls persist across difficulties, and following the full route reaches the halfway mark during Mission 7.

steps.text: Use Mission Select to follow the Lost Soul cleanup through Missions 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6, then free the sixth Lost Soul in @loc{Mission 7: Overturn} to reach 40 total.

achievements.displayName: Fill your dark soul with light
achievements.description: Free all of the Lost Souls
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Free all 80 @npc{Lost Souls} spread across 14 of Dante’s missions.

guide.context: Collected Souls disappear permanently on later replays, while Mission Select displays each mission’s remaining completion count.

steps.text: Free all 6 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 1: Found}: one behind the red crystal after Kat, one on the main route, one above the carousel-side passage, and three around the doll-lined stairway and circular room.
steps.note: Return with @item{Eryx} for the first crystal and @mechanic{Angel Lift} for the two elevated routes.

steps.text: Free all 9 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 2: Home Truths}: search the Main Hall side room, both upper stair routes, the portrait-room exit, the corridor behind blue vines, the room before the red grips, the room before the Divinity Statue, and the outdoor room beyond the broken floor.
steps.note: The blocked paths collectively require Angel Lift, Angel Boost, @item{Aquila}, and @item{Osiris}.

steps.text: Free all 3 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 3: Bloodline}: look above the starting point after Kat’s ground-collapse scene, clear the blue vines above the square after its second fight, and Angel Boost to the separate platform on the blue-rose ascent.
steps.note: The second and third Souls require Aquila and Angel Boost.

steps.text: Free all 8 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 4: Under Watch}: check the arches after the first fight, the wall at the first junction, both branches of the split staircase, both high walls around the fountain square, the balcony route at the second junction, and the terrace reached after pulling Kat’s stairs.
steps.note: Use the fountain and the nearby terrace for the two high fountain-square Souls.

steps.text: Free all 6 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 5: Virility}: inspect the first warehouse container reached by blue grips, both sides of the first large combat platform, the container after the first Demon Pull, and both levels beside the exit of the later arena.
steps.note: The sixth Soul is behind blue vines on a container and requires Aquila before taking the following blue grips.

steps.text: Free both Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 6: Secret Ingredient}: check high on the left after the first Demon Pull and grip sequence, then inspect the left column at the tunnel exit after the timed descent.
steps.note: Neither Soul must be collected during the timed enemy challenge; the second appears after that section ends.

steps.text: Free all 8 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 7: Overturn}: check left before the Penitentiary red crystal, take the Aquila route after two boosted grips, search the fenced Gold Door area, inspect behind the wall after the Rage, circle the elevator platforms, sweep the room after riding down, and check right of the late Divinity Statue.
steps.note: Angel Boost is needed to circle the upper elevator platforms.

steps.text: Free all 5 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 8: Eyeless}: clear the Aquila vines right of the first red wall, check the railway tunnel entrance, search the right alcove after the Divinity Statue, and ride both labeled grip routes before activating the large circular room.
steps.note: The first Soul shares its hidden room with the Copper Door for Secret Mission 7.

steps.text: Free both Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 9: Devil Inside}: enter through the blue vines after the bridge’s red barrier, then Angel Boost around the right side of the next building to reach the Soul visible through its window.
steps.note: Both Souls sit on short detours from the mandatory route.

steps.text: Free all 7 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 11: The Order}: search below the first Vital Star, the left wall of the circular base room, four side rooms around the closing-door corridor, and the arch above the late circular arena.
steps.note: Cross the closing door before exploring the corridor; reaching its far side stops the lockout and permits safe backtracking.

steps.text: Free all 7 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 13: Devil’s Dalliance}: check above the arena entrance and below its ramp, then search the right path after the first Play square, the blue room after Round 3, the left translucent path after Round 4, and both detours around the Divinity Statue after Round 5.
steps.note: Several Souls sit on optional platforms opened by Play squares and blue grips.

steps.text: Free all 9 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 16: The Plan}: break the red scratches before the first elevator, circle the elevator on floor 105, explore the stairwell behind the floor-106 elevator, drop one level before the next grips for three Souls, turn left after the laser bridge, and continue straight before entering the second skybridge.
steps.note: The three-Soul office detour begins by dropping from floor 106 before taking the next blue grips.

steps.text: Free all 5 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 17: Furnace of Souls}: take the opening right path, explore the left-side platforms for the first two, sweep the right edge of the large combat platform, check the wall after the Divinity Statue, and circle the rock column after the first grips beyond the final arena.
steps.note: Patient movement also protects the separate requirement to avoid furnace damage.

steps.text: Free all 3 Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 18: Demon’s Den}: check the high left platform at the first right-hand generator, look above the drop in the first left tunnel, and search the right platform where the second left tunnel widens.
steps.note: All three can be collected while activating the four generators.

achievements.description: Gain a 100% completion rank on all missions (difficulty doesn't matter)
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% completion on every one of Dante’s 20 missions on any mixture of difficulties.

guide.context: Completion credit is shared across difficulties and depends on permanent collectible progress, so it should be finished before Nephilim SSS attempts.

steps.text: Collect all 21 Keys, open all 21 Secret Doors, and free all 80 Lost Souls using Mission Select to locate any mission below 100%.
Open Mission Select and verify that every mission from 1 through 20 displays 100% completion.

achievements.description: Complete a mission with a SSS rank
achievements.sortReason: Attempt after every mission has 100% completion.
achievements.summary: Earn an overall @mechanic{SSS mission rank} on any completed mission.

guide.context: Overall score multiplies Style Points by the Clear Time and Completion grades, while each death removes 10% of the result.

steps.text: Choose a fully completed mission on Nephilim so the Completion multiplier can reach SSS.
Finish quickly, vary attacks to build Style Points, avoid deaths, and reach the results screen with an overall SSS grade.

achievements.description: Complete all missions on the Son of Sparda difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Complete all 20 main-game missions on @mechanic{Son of Sparda} difficulty.

guide.context: Son of Sparda unlocks after any Human, Devil Hunter, or Nephilim campaign clear and uses altered enemy groups.

steps.text: Finish Mission 20 on one initial difficulty to unlock Son of Sparda.
Use Mission Select to complete Missions 1 through 20 on Son of Sparda, checking that each mission has a recorded clear.

achievements.description: Complete all missions on the Dante Must Die difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Finish during later difficulty runs or final farming.
achievements.summary: Complete all 20 main-game missions on @mechanic{Dante Must Die} difficulty.

guide.context: Dante Must Die unlocks after Son of Sparda and allows enemies to enter Devil Trigger.

steps.text: Complete every mission on Son of Sparda to unlock Dante Must Die.
Complete Missions 1 through 20 on Dante Must Die; use items when necessary because item penalties do not matter for this completion achievement.

achievements.displayName: This is what I live for!
achievements.description: Complete all missions on the Heaven or Hell difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Finish during later difficulty runs or final farming.
achievements.summary: Complete all 20 main-game missions on @mechanic{Heaven or Hell} difficulty.

guide.context: Heaven or Hell unlocks after Son of Sparda; Dante and most enemies die in one hit, and three Yellow Orbs provide checkpoint retries.

steps.text: Complete Son of Sparda to unlock Heaven or Hell.
Complete all 20 missions on Heaven or Hell, shooting ordinary enemies from range and removing shields before the finishing shot.

achievements.description: Complete all missions on the Hell and Hell difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Finish during later difficulty runs or final farming.
achievements.summary: Complete all 20 main-game missions on @mechanic{Hell and Hell} difficulty.

guide.context: Hell and Hell unlocks after Dante Must Die. Super Dante supplies infinite Devil Trigger but halves score, which is harmless for a clear-only run.

steps.text: Complete Dante Must Die to unlock both Hell and Hell and the Super Dante costume.
Equip @item{Super Dante}, use Devil Trigger for combat safety, and complete Missions 1 through 20 on Hell and Hell.

achievements.description: Complete all missions on the Nephilim difficulty with a SSS rank
achievements.sortReason: Attempt after every mission has 100% completion.
achievements.summary: Earn an overall @mechanic{SSS rank} on all 20 main-game missions on Nephilim difficulty.

guide.context: SSS Clear Time and SSS Completion multiply Style Points by 64; one SS multiplier lowers that to 56, while every death reduces the final score by 10%.

steps.text: Raise every mission to 100% completion before starting the ranked Nephilim route.
Aim to finish Missions 1–10 within these SSS Clear Time targets: 8:20, 14:10, 7:00, 10:40, 14:10, 5:00, 11:00, 9:10, 7:30, and 6:40, respectively.
Aim to finish Missions 11–20 within these SSS Clear Time targets: 10:50, 12:10, 14:40, 3:50, 2:30, 18:20, 10:40, 12:00, 3:30, and 3:00, respectively.
Replay all 20 missions on Nephilim, vary attacks for Style Points, beat the listed time target, and avoid deaths until every results screen records an overall SSS rank.
For Mission 20, trigger Demon Evade bonuses, shoot the white blades with @item{Revenant}, and use Devil Trigger when the boss is nearly defeated and recovering.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Secret Missions
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Complete any 10 of the 21 Secret Missions unlocked from Dante’s Secret Doors.

guide.context: Once a Secret Door has been opened, its challenge can be launched later from the main menu and does not inherit the story difficulty.

steps.text: Collect matching Keys and open at least 10 Secret Doors during the campaign.
Launch opened Secret Missions immediately or from the main menu and finish 10 distinct challenges.

achievements.description: Complete all of the Secret Missions
achievements.sortReason: Combine with Son of Sparda and permanent collectible cleanup.
achievements.summary: Complete all 21 Secret Missions after opening every Secret Door.

guide.context: Secret Mission access is permanent once its door opens, allowing failed challenges to be retried outside the story mission.

steps.text: Collect all 21 Keys and open all 21 matching Secret Doors.
Use the main menu’s Secret Mission list to complete every numbered challenge from 1 through 21.

achievements.description: Defeat a Wisp
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first DLC completion route.
achievements.summary: Defeat a @enemy{Wisp} during the @loc{Vergil’s Downfall} campaign.

guide.context: Wisp encounters belong to the DLC’s six-mission route and remain replayable through its Mission Select.

steps.text: Continue through Vergil’s Downfall until a Wisp appears, break its defense with Vergil’s summoned swords, and defeat the exposed enemy.

achievements.description: Defeat an Imprisoner
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first DLC completion route.
achievements.summary: Defeat an @enemy{Imprisoner} during the @loc{Vergil’s Downfall} campaign.

guide.context: The enemy appears during required DLC progression and can be fought again through Mission Select.

steps.text: Advance through Vergil’s Downfall to the first Imprisoner encounter, avoid its heavy attacks, and deplete its full health bar.

achievements.displayName: Our souls are at odds brother
achievements.description: Complete Vergil's downfall
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first DLC completion route.
achievements.summary: Complete all six missions in the @loc{Vergil’s Downfall} campaign.

guide.context: The DLC is separate from Dante’s 20-mission campaign and maintains its own upgrades, collectibles, and difficulty records.

steps.text: Finish Vergil’s Downfall Missions 1 through 6 on Human, Devil Hunter, or Nephilim and clear the final results screen.

achievements.displayName: I've come to retrieve my power
achievements.description: Acquire all of Vergil's health, Devil trigger and combat upgrades
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first DLC completion route.
achievements.summary: Obtain every health, Devil Trigger, and combat upgrade available to @npc{Vergil}.

guide.context: Vergil’s upgrades belong to the separate six-mission DLC save path; progress earned by Dante cannot fill any part of this requirement.

steps.text: In @loc{Vergil’s Downfall Mission 1}, take the four Health Cross Fragments from the debris at the first building’s hallway end, the Angel Boost platform outside that building, the wooden door beside the collapsed hallway floor, and the wall two platforms beyond the Demon Pull.

In @loc{Mission 2}, collect the three fragments from the platform left of the first arch, the left side of the arch on the Divinity Statue’s right route, and the platform beside the small hallway on the statue’s left route; take the full Health Cross from the obelisk platform in the falling-rock area.

In @loc{Mission 3}, collect four fragments: make the right-wall U-turn after the early Angel grip, pull the left-side rock from the second materialized train car, backtrack after the corridor cutscene into the previous area’s left opening, and look down left before the second grip around the huge statue.

In @loc{Mission 4}, collect four fragments from the platform left of the first portal stairs, behind the wooden boards after the second portal’s Divinity Statue, around the large rock below the red tree after portal three, and below the Divinity Statue reached after portal five.

In @loc{Mission 6}, collect the fragment inside the next building entrance, two more behind the cracked wall and on the following floating platform, climb enemies with Demon Pull and Enemy Step to reach the fragment atop the triangular rock near the dead tree, and take the last fragment inside the building reached by two consecutive Angel grips.
Free all 20 Lost Souls, collect all 20 Health Cross Fragments plus the complete Health Cross, and bring each of the six DLC missions to 100% completion.
Spend Vergil’s upgrade points on every combat ability, then buy every health and Devil Trigger upgrade still offered at a Divinity Statue until no required upgrade remains.

achievements.description: Gain a 100% completion rank on all missions in Vergil's downfall (difficulty doesn't matter)
achievements.sortReason: Earn during the first DLC completion route.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% completion on all six @loc{Vergil’s Downfall} missions on any difficulties.

guide.context: DLC collectible progress persists across its difficulty modes, so the six-mission cleanup can be combined with Son of Sparda.

steps.text: Free the four @npc{Lost Souls} in @loc{Mission 1}: the left corridor inside the first building, the platform left of the first Angel grip, the corridor beside the late Divinity Statue, and the ledge below the second of two consecutive Angel grips.

Free the three Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 2}: beside the descending stairs on the Divinity Statue’s left route, atop the next large arch via its rear Angel grip, and left of the path near the lava cascade after the boosted grips.

Free the four Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 3}: above the opening right path’s small arch, on the rocky route right of the materialized train cars, along the right side of the post-cutscene corridor, and around the left wall before the gap in the semicircular hallway.

Free the four Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 4}: right of the first portal stairs, on the boosted platform reached after leaving the post-fight rock passage, above the upside-down portal after portal three, and behind the fourth portal.

Free all five Lost Souls in @loc{Mission 6}: behind the first floating platform, above the next building entrance, left of the collapsing interior floor, high over the exterior combat exit using Demon Pull and Enemy Step, and inside the final building’s second room.
Collect every Health Cross Fragment and full Health Cross from the same five missions, then use Mission Select to confirm that Missions 1 through 6 each display 100% completion.

achievements.displayName: I'll try it your way for once
achievements.description: Complete all missions in Vergil's downfall on the Nephilim difficulty with a SSS rank
achievements.sortReason: Finish during the DLC difficulty and rank route.
achievements.summary: Earn an overall @mechanic{SSS rank} on all six Vergil’s Downfall missions on Nephilim.

guide.context: Spiral Swords stagger enemies, deal passive damage, and increase Style quickly; the Mission 5 boss is the main scoring obstacle.

steps.text: Reach 100% completion in all six DLC missions before beginning the Nephilim rank runs.
Use varied melee attacks with Spiral Swords active and avoid deaths until Missions 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6 record SSS.
In Mission 5, counter the boss with @mechanic{Killer Bee}, @mechanic{Dive/Stomp}, @mechanic{Slasher}, or @mechanic{Divorce}; after a stagger, chain @mechanic{Aerial Flush} to hold the boss in place.

During Mission 5 rounds two and three, keep @mechanic{Spiral Swords} active, remain at range between openings, and resume Aerial Flush after the next stagger; complete the results screen with an overall SSS rank.

achievements.description: Complete Vergil's downfall on Son of Sparda difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Finish during the DLC difficulty and rank route.
achievements.summary: Complete all six Vergil’s Downfall missions on @mechanic{Son of Sparda}.

guide.context: The DLC uses its own difficulty progression, independent of Dante’s campaign records.

steps.text: Finish Vergil’s Downfall once on an initial difficulty to unlock Son of Sparda.
Complete DLC Missions 1 through 6 on Son of Sparda.

achievements.displayName: This is the power of Sparda!
achievements.description: Complete Vergil's downfall on Vergil Must Die difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Finish during the DLC difficulty and rank route.
achievements.summary: Complete all six Vergil’s Downfall missions on @mechanic{Vergil Must Die}.

guide.context: Vergil Must Die unlocks after the DLC’s Son of Sparda clear and is the hardest conventional DLC mode.

steps.text: Complete every Vergil’s Downfall mission on Son of Sparda to unlock Vergil Must Die.
Complete DLC Missions 1 through 6 on Vergil Must Die, using items as needed because rank is irrelevant.

achievements.description: Complete Vergil's downfall on Heaven or Hell difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Finish during the DLC difficulty and rank route.
achievements.summary: Complete all six Vergil’s Downfall missions on @mechanic{Heaven or Hell}.

guide.context: Heaven or Hell unlocks from the DLC’s Son of Sparda clear and makes most targets die from one summoned sword.

steps.text: Complete Vergil’s Downfall on Son of Sparda to unlock Heaven or Hell.
Finish all six DLC missions on Heaven or Hell, attacking from range with summoned swords whenever possible.

achievements.displayName: You're not worthy as my opponent
achievements.description: Complete Vergil's downfall on Hell and Hell difficulty
achievements.sortReason: Finish during the DLC difficulty and rank route.
achievements.summary: Complete all six Vergil’s Downfall missions on @mechanic{Hell and Hell}.

guide.context: Vergil Must Die unlocks Hell and Hell plus Super Vergil; the costume’s score penalty does not matter for this clear.

steps.text: Complete all DLC missions on Vergil Must Die to unlock Hell and Hell and @item{Super Vergil}.
Equip Super Vergil, use its unlimited Devil Trigger throughout the clear, and complete DLC Missions 1 through 6 on Hell and Hell.
During Mission 5 rounds two and three, keep Spiral Swords active so incoming attacks can consume the swords instead of ending the one-hit run.
